Erdbeer Fruit Cakes wie von Cedric Grolet🍓 • Für die Creme - 250g kalte Mascarpone  - 200ml kalte Schlagsahne - 3-5 EL gezuckerte Kondensmilch - 300ml Milch - 2 Vanilleschoten - 1 TL Vanilleextrakt  - 3 Eigelb (M) - 100g Zucker - 30g Mehl - 1 Päckchen Sahnesteif Milch, Zucker, Eigelb, Mehl & Vanilleschoten in den Topf, verrühren → unter Rühren bei mittlerer Hitze aufkochen, bis Pudding entsteht Vom Herd nehmen, in Teller füllen, Folie drauf & min. 5 Std. in den Kühlschrank. Mascarpone und die gezuckerte Kondensmilch ür 10 Sekunden mit einem Handmixer verrühren und gleich danach die Sahne dazugießen, gleich hinterher Sahnesteif dazu und für etwa 1 Minute cremig aufschlagen. Den kalten Pudding 1-2 Minuten cremig schlagen, dann zu der Mascarpone Sahne Creme geben und bei niedriger Stufe miteinander verrühren.  • Für die Fruchtfüllung -500g gefrorene oder frische Erebeeren - 5 EL brauner Zucker - 300-350g in Würfel geschnittene Erdbeeren Für die Erdbeerfüllung gefrorene Erdbeeren mit braunem Zucker im Topf leicht karamellisieren lassen – also einfach erhitzen, bis sie weich werden und richtig schön süß duften. Dann alles fein pürieren und frische, klein geschnittene Erdbeeren unterheben. Die Masse kommt dann in die Silikonform und wird für mindestens 3 Stunden eingefroren. • Für den Biskuitboden: - 4 Eier - 3 EL warmes Wasser  - 130g Zucker - 1 Päckchen Vanillezucker  - 100g Mehl - 50g Speisestärke  - 2 TL Backpulver  Für den Biskuit werden Eier, warmes Wasser, Zucker und Vanillezucker auf höchster Stufe etwa 7–10 Minuten aufgeschlagen, bis die Masse richtig hell, cremig und schön voluminös ist. Wenn sie beim Anheben eine Spur zieht, die nicht sofort wieder einsinkt, ist sie perfekt  Anschließend werden Mehl, Speisestärke und Backpulver in einer separaten Schüssel gut miteinander vermischt und in drei Etappen fein in die Eiermasse gesiebt. Nach jeder Etappe wird die Mischung vorsichtig untergehoben, damit die Luft in der Masse bleibt und der Teig schön luftig wird  Der Teig wird dann auf ein mit Backpapier belegtes Blech gegeben und im vorgeheizten Backofen bei 175 °C Ober-/Unterhitze ca. 20–25 Minuten gebacken, bis er goldgelb ist. Danach abgedeckt abkühlen lassen, damit er schön weich bleibt. • Für die Glasur  - 150g Kakaobutter - 150 weiße Kuvertüre  - rote fettlösliche Lebensmittelfarbe von Colormill Schokolade + Kakaobutter in der Mikrowelle schmelzen (alle 30 Sek.rühren)  Temperatur: 38 °C Gefrorene Erdbeeren aufspießen ,eintauchen, Messer vorsichtig abziehen.  Für die Fertigstellung wird zuerst etwas von der Creme in die Silikonform gegeben und gleichmäßig verteilt. Darauf kommen die gefrorenen Erdbeerkugeln aus der ersten Form. Anschließend wird wieder eine Schicht Creme darübergegeben und zum Abschluss der Biskuitboden aufgelegt, sodass die Form vollständig gefüllt ist. Das Ganze kommt dann für mindestens 4–5 Stunden in den Gefrierschrank, bis alles komplett durchgefroren ist. Nach dem Herausnehmen werden die gefrorenen Erdbeerfrüchte mit Schokolade überzogen. Damit die Füllung im Inneren später schön weich und leicht cremig ist, lässt man die fertigen Erdbeerfrüchte anschließend 2–3 Stunden im Kühlschrank auftauen, bevor sie serviert werden. videos.caption: Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Warm up sauce in a pan, serve on a wrap with fresh lettuce and enjoy . . . . #garlicparmesan #chickenwrap #chickenrecipes #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Ingredients Meat Mixture • 1 lb ground beef (85/15) • 1 small yellow onion, grated and squeezed dry • 5 garlic cloves, finely grated • 1 grated jalapeño • 2 tbsp tomato paste • ⅓ cup parsley, finely chopped • ¼ cup cilantro, finely chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tbsp ice water • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp cumin • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp allspice • 1 tsp coriander • 1 tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp cinnamon Other • 4 pitas, cut in half Garlic Tahini Yogurt Sauce • ¾ cup Greek yogurt • ¼ cup tahini • 3 garlic cloves, finely grated • Juice of ½ lemon • 1 tbsp olive oil • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp cumin • 2 tbsp parsley, finely chopped • 2 tbsp cilantro, finely chopped Instructions 1. Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

Polish Smalec 🇵🇱 | Poor Man's Butter They call it Poor Man's Butter, so I guess the rich are missing out. Polish Smalec is a rich, savory spread made by slowly rendering pork fat with bacon, onions, apples and marjoram. Once cooled, it becomes firm and perfectly spreadable. Best served generously on fresh rustic bread with pickles or fresh tomatoes. Recipe 👇 Poor Man's Butter – Polish Smalec ( Traditional Bacon & Apple Spread ) Ingredients ◆ 500 g ( 1.1 lb ) pork fat, cut into small cubes or coarsely ground ◆ 500 g ( 1.1 lb ) pork belly or fatty bacon, cut into small cubes or coarsely ground ◆ 3 onions, finely diced ◆ 2 apples, peeled and diced ◆ 1 tsp salt ◆ ½ tsp ground black pepper ◆ 1 tsp dried marjoram Instructions 1️⃣ Place the pork fat in a large heavy-bottomed pot or skillet. Cook over low heat for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until a good amount of fat has rendered. 2️⃣ Add the pork belly or fatty bacon. Continue cooking slowly over low heat for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until the pieces become golden brown and much of their fat has rendered. 3️⃣ Add the diced onions and apples. Continue cooking until the onions are soft and translucent and everything begins to turn golden. 4️⃣ Stir in the salt, black pepper, and dried marjoram. Remove from the heat and mix well. 5️⃣ Carefully pour the hot mixture into clean jars or a large glass bowl. 6️⃣ Let it cool completely until the rendered fat turns pale, firm, and spreadable. Serving Suggestions Spread generously over fresh bread and serve with pickles or fresh tomatoes. The rich, savory spread is especially delicious with a little salt and a side of crunchy pickled vegetables. #PolishFood #PolishSmalec #PoorMansButter #TasteTheEast #EasternEuropeanFood
